properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 14 at 8:58PM MDT until August 15 at 3:00AM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding due to excessive rainfall will persist over the
next several hours after 3 to 5 inches of rainfall was observed
this evening.

* WHERE...Central Elbert County in east central Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 300 AM MDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas will
continue.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 853 PM MDT, Between 3 to 5 inches of heavy rainfall fell
this evening. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to persist in
the advisory area for the next several hours.

- This includes the following streams and drainages...
Comanche Creek, Hay Gulch, Spring Branch, Wilson Creek, East
Bijou Creek, Antelope Creek, West Bijou Creek and Middle Bijou
Creek.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Central Elbert County.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 14 at 8:55PM MDT until August 15 at 12:00AM MDT by NWS Goodland KS
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...West Central Yuma County in northeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until midnight MDT tonight.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 854 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Yuma.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 14 at 8:52PM MDT until August 14 at 10:15PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall

* WHERE...North Central Washington County in northeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 1015 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Rises in small streams and normally dry creeks.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 851 PM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges

- Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Akron, Midway and Fremont Butte.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 14 at 8:37PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 837 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms extending from over Ovid to 8 miles southeast of
Highland Center, or extending from 5 miles west of Julesburg to 15
miles southwest of Holyoke, moving east at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Holyoke, Julesburg, Ovid, Sedgwick, Paoli, Sixteen-Mile Corner,
Amherst, Fairfield, Marks Butte, Pleasant Valley and Highland
Center.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 14 at 7:37PM MDT until August 14 at 10:30PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
FFWBOU

The National Weather Service in Denver has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Washington County in northeastern Colorado...

* Until 1030 PM MDT.

* At 737 PM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between
0.5 and 3 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts
up to 1 inch are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is
ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, gulches,
roads, and poor drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Arickaree School, Anton and Elba.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
North Fork Arikaree River, Jack Creek, Arikaree River and Gordon
Creek.
